title: Atrofdagi narsalarni atash
can_do: O'z atrofidagi asosiy narsalarni inglizcha atasiz
why: O'z atrofida bo'lgan narsalarni inglizcha atash — bu darslarda ishlatiladigan eng asosiy so'zlar. Majburiy atama parser orqali ishlatiladigan so'zlarga ko'proq kirishadi.

points.text: Ingliz tilida o'z atrofidagi narsalarni atashda asosiy much bir xil shaklda ishlatiladi: masalan, table — stol, chair — stul. Bundan keyin inglizcha birlik bilan ishlatiladi: a table, a chair.

examples.en: a table — stol, a chair — stul
examples.uz: a table — stol, a chair — stul

examples.en: I see a table. — Men stolni ko'raman.
examples.uz: I see a table. — Men stolni ko'raman.

points.text: Otlar birlikda ishlatiladi: a table, a chair, a cup. Lekin ba'zi so'zlar bir necha shaklda ishlatiladi: masalan, shop — do'kondan (otlar — keylari), book — kitob.

examples.en: a book — kitob, a pen — qalam
examples.uz: a book — kitob, a pen — qalam

points.text: Ba'zi otlar shunga o'xshash yoki biri-biriga o'xshash. Masalan, clock va watch — bu yerda bir xil atama, lekin clock — soat (stol soati), watch — soat (barmoqda ulangan).

examples.en: a clock — stol soati, a watch — barmoq soati
examples.uz: a clock — stol soati, a watch — barmoq soati

examples.en: What time is it? — Soat necha?
examples.uz: What time is it? — Soat necha?

head: O'zbekcha
Inglizcha
Misol gap
rows: The clock is on the wall.

common_errors.wrong: table — stol — inglizcha birlik sha kiladi:emas
common_errors.why: Ingliz tilida ot — birlik bilan ishlatiladi: a table, a chair emas, faqat table emas

common_errors.wrong: clock — soat, watch — soat — barcha soat bir xil
common_errors.right: clock — stol soati, watch — barmoqda ulangan soat (boshqa ma'noda)
common_errors.why: clock va watch — bir xil emas, clock — hozirgi soati, watch — boshqa soat
shop — inglizcha do'kondan, o'zbekcha do'kondan emas

words.example: The table is near the window.
The box is on the table.
The lamp is on the desk.

practice_spec.note: Mashqlarni AI shu spetsifikatsiya bo'yicha yaratadi — tur raqamlari docs/mashqlar.md.

items.focus: otning inglizcha nomini to'g'ri tanlash: stol — table, stul — chair
bo'sh joyni to'g'ri to'ldirish: a ... on the table — cup / box / phone
xato qilingan otmatchilar: clock — watch bir xil, key — chaqir emas
o'z hujjatida bo'lgan narsani 3 gap yozish (a table, a chair, a cup)
tarjima: «Men stulda otam» — I am on the chair emas, I am sitting on the chair — a tashqi so'z mobil tarmog'i emas

final.task: O'z xonangizdagi 6 ta narsani inglizcha atang: a table ..., a chair ..., a cup ...

skill_task.task: Amaliy mashkel: suhbatdagi narsalarni tingla — a table, a chair, a cup. Har bir narsani tushunib, o'ziga xos gap isting: «I see a table...» Shunda siz yordam berasiz.
